headline: Key protocol contracts identified on Ethereum; full address enumeration blocked by SDK-based deployments lookup

findings.text: Etherscan name-tag search for 'Nexus Mutual' identified 8 core protocol contracts on Ethereum with Nexus Mutual tags: NXM Token (0xd7c49cee7e9188cca6ad8ff264c1da2e69d4cf3b), Pool (0xfd61352232157815cf7b71045557192bf0ce1884), Master Proxy (0x01bfd82675dbcc7762c84019ca518e701c0cd07e), Member Roles 2 (0x055cc48f7968fd8640ef140610dd4038e1b03926), Pooled Staking Proxy (0x84edffa16bb0b9ab1163abb0a13ff0744c11272f), Community Fund (0x586b9b2f8010b284a0197f392156f1a7eb5e86e9), Community Staking Incentives (0x27e6d3Ce99Fa5ec4019Ce598aF54bcB3A2FB2E5f), Claims (0x813174d3eC6f7C11f4364a637cEf0f1CD6176139)

Deployed contracts doc not directly accessible via docs.nexusmutual.io; documentation states 'Contract addresses can be found in our SDK' (https://docs.nexusmutual.io/developers/contracts/), indicating addresses are maintained in a deployments package rather than a public listing page

Audit links page (https://docs.nexusmutual.io/resources/audits-and-security/) lists 14 audit reports from iosiro (March 2025 through January 2024), Chaos Labs (October 2023), G0 Group (June 2020, November 2020, March 2021), and Solidified (April 2019). Audit PDFs link externally; not all include contract address tables in scope sections

GitHub repository https://github.com/NexusMutual/smart-contracts identified; repository contains release tags and audit references but addresses not directly embedded in README or visible from search results; deployments likely in @nexusmutual/deployments package (referenced in PR descriptions)
Protocol pinned to Ethereum only; single-chain protocol, so D5 multi-chain enumeration not required
D6 factory enumeration not performed; no factory contracts identified in Etherscan search results

8 contracts catalogued with roles: 'token' (NXM), 'pool' (Pool1), 'admin' (Master Proxy), 'multisig' (Member Roles 2), 'proxy' (Pooled Staking Proxy, Master Proxy), 'treasury' (Community Fund), 'other' (Community Staking Incentives, Claims); actor classes classified as 'multisig' or 'governance' where evident from proxy patterns
All 8 catalogued addresses trace to Etherscan name-tag search results with direct URLs; no snippet-only findings

rationale.verdict: Discovery partial: core protocol contracts on Ethereum identified via Etherscan name-tag search (8 contracts), but canonical deployments doc points to SDK/package rather than a public address listing. Multiple audits cited (14 reports) but full in-scope address extraction from audit PDFs not performed. GitHub repo located but deployment artifacts not directly fetched. Next assessment should retrieve SDK/package addresses and audit PDF scopes to complete enumeration.

protocol_metadata.about: Nexus Mutual is a community-owned insurance alternative on Ethereum that enables members to pool and share risks through a discretionary mutual. Members purchase smart contract cover to protect funds against smart contract hacks, custody failures, slashing, and depeg events, with claims assessed by community members and paid from a shared capital pool. The protocol is governed by NXM token-weighted voting and operates through multiple upgradeable smart contracts managed via proxy patterns.
